svg.title: LSM tree compaction process (size-tiered)
svg.desc: Writes enter a memtable, flush as SSTables into L0, then compact downward into sorted runs of increasing size. SlateDB uses size-tiered compaction: there is no explicit L1, L2; runs are ordered by size, and the scheduler groups runs of similar size for compaction.
svg.text: SlateDB uses size-tiered compaction: no explicit L1/L2/L3. Runs are ordered by size,
and the scheduler groups runs within include_size_threshold of each other.
Size acts as a proxy for depth — smaller SRs are younger.
